versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.4

- Fixed text encoding issues in the skill description and documentation (all smart quotes, dashes, and emoji now rendered correctly).
- Updated documentation to add "Upgrade to Iris Pro" instructions with purchase and installation details.
- Bumped version from 1.0.1 to 1.0.4 in metadata.
- No changes to source code; documentation and metadata updates only.
Improvement: better IMAP error checklist, improved draft logic, cleaner urgency detection

Iris 1.0.0 – Rainbow Messenger: Intelligent Gmail triage, reply drafting, and daily action planning.

- Scores every Gmail message by urgency and sender importance; auto-flags attachments and meetings.
- Drafts context-aware replies for your top 5 emails; produces a color-coded action report.
- No OAuth required: works via Gmail app password—quick setup.
- Supports custom VIP senders, customizable scan count, and context for drafts (name/role).
- Easy-to-use, read-only connection; all results export to a tidy Markdown inbox report.
